notes.title: Soulstopia -PHI- Released
notes.content:
Hi everybody!

Soulstopia -PHI- is now available for purchase and with that we have special artwork to celebrate the occasion:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41212932/2461b60abc97dad8b5624fa019a573af9c426bbd.jpg[/img]

Thank you for your continued support; we hope you enjoy the game.

[h2]Devlog:[/h2] You can find a blog post on the game's development from the creator, NWArtworks,  [url=https://nicolaswagner.itch.io/soulstopia-phi/devlog/298283/soulstopia-phi-is-out-now-developmental-history]here[/url]
